title: Investigation of Mg-Zn-Y-Nd alloy for potential application of biodegradable esophageal stent material

nodes.label: 317L SS esophageal stents are hard, cause extra injury and pain, and do not inhibit the cells that drive restenosis

requires_unseen: 317L SS is the current esophageal cancer stent metal (linked text F2)
high stent hardness causes extra injury and pain (linked text F2)
317L SS has no inhibitory effect on restenosis-related cells (linked text F6)

nodes.label: A soft, biodegradable Mg-based alloy should outperform 317L SS as an esophageal stent: degrade, alkalise the site and inhibit pathological cells
Choose the Mg-Zn-Y-Nd alloy as the candidate biodegradable esophageal stent metal

requires_unseen: alloy system and stent purpose stated in title and linked text

nodes.label: Compare Mg-Zn-Y-Nd with the incumbent 317L SS in surface, corrosion, immersion (1-30 d) and cell-culture (4 h-3 d) tests

attrs.variable: material (Mg-Zn-Y-Nd vs 317L SS) x exposure time
requires_unseen: 317L SS chosen as incumbent comparator (captions, linked text)

nodes.label: Immerse both metals in Hank's solution at 37 C and retrieve after 1, 3, 7, 10, 15, 22 and 30 days

requires_unseen: Hank's solution at 37 C (linked text, caption F4)

nodes.label: Degradation opens a porous surface on Mg-Zn-Y-Nd that coarsens into a deep cellular network by 22-30 days; 317L SS stays flat
Mg-Zn-Y-Nd degrades far faster than 317L SS: much lower corrosion potential, ~3 decades higher corrosion current, higher immersion corrosion rate
Mg dissolution consumes water and releases hydroxide (Mg + 2H2O -> Mg2+ + 2OH- + H2), so degrading Mg alkalises the medium

requires_unseen: Mg + 2H2O -> Mg2+ + 2OH- + H2 dissolution stoichiometry (prior knowledge, k1)

nodes.label: Immersed Mg-Zn-Y-Nd drives Hank's solution to pH ~10 and holds it there, above the blank control; 317L SS does not
Mg-Zn-Y-Nd is less wettable than 317L SS: water contact angle about 60 vs 28 degrees
Fewer cells adhere and fewer remain vital on Mg-Zn-Y-Nd than on 317L SS in all four cell cultures
A degrading Mg-Zn-Y-Nd stent could neutralise the acidic esophageal tumour environment, an advantage over 317L SS

attrs.condition: advanced esophageal cancer site (argued, not tested)
requires_unseen: tumour focus is chronically acidic (linked text)

nodes.label: Mg-Zn-Y-Nd should suppress the cancer, fibroblast, squamous and inflammatory cells that cause stent restenosis

requires_unseen: Eca109, L929, Het-1A participate in restenosis; macrophages drive inflammation (linked text, refs 17-18)

nodes.label: Mg-Zn-Y-Nd is a promising biodegradable esophageal stent material with advantages over 317L SS

requires_unseen: stent-application conclusion stated in title and linked text

nodes.label: Mg-Zn-Y-Nd is much softer than 317L SS: microhardness about 54 vs 199 HV
A softer, smooth Mg-Zn-Y-Nd stent should cause less injury and pain at implantation than 317L SS

requires_unseen: hardness and roughness linked to implantation injury and pain (linked text F1-F2)

nodes.label: Both metal surfaces are smooth at the tens-of-nm scale; Mg-Zn-Y-Nd (~57 nm) is rougher than 317L SS (~32 nm)
Mg corrodes in aqueous media by Mg + 2H2O -> Mg(OH)2 + H2, raising local pH
Eca109, L929 and Het-1A cells participate in esophageal stent restenosis; macrophages are the main inflammatory cells

requires_unseen: refs 17-18 as cited in linked text

nodes.label: Immersion corrosion rate of Mg-Zn-Y-Nd (0.13-0.38 mm/y, peak at day 7) stays above 317L SS (<0.07 mm/y) at every time point

edges.mode_basis: linked text names hardness and smoothness together as reducing pain; neither caption nor figure weighs one against the other

edges.note: caption: values from the polarization curves; Tafel extrapolation presumed, method not stated in packet

notes: Two spine branches from the material comparison: degradation (immersion -> porous attack -> high degradability -> alkalisation -> acid-neutralising advantage) and surface/cell (low wettability -> fewer vital cells -> anti-restenosis). Hardness/roughness -> less pain kept as a side branch to respect the two-branch limit. No processing route, composition or microstructure of the alloy is in the packet. The cell-inhibition cause is only argued (contact angle, linked text); no degradation-product or pH link to culture is shown. Audits: SS pH below blank control (o9), non-significant cell comparisons (o13), Het-1A/macrophage growth on Mg (o14), absent EB-red cells (o15).
